title: Question 1.3: Label Conversion - withColumn Method
code_section: Data Loading - Label Conversion with withColumn (Lines 264-267)
instruction: Sometimes we need to change the format of our data to make it easier for the computer to work with. This code is transforming text labels into numbers.
reveal: This code creates a new column called "label" that converts the text sentiment values into numbers. If the sentiment is "positive", it becomes 1. Otherwise (if it's "negative"), it becomes 0. Then it selects only the "text" and "label" columns, keeping just what we need. Machine learning algorithms often work better with numbers than text labels.
